# Delay <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Delay:Void millisecs:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `millisecs` | In | Int32 | required | How long to wait, in milliseconds. |

## Description

Pauses the program for a number of milliseconds. The window keeps working while it waits. A value of 0 or less returns right away.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
start = MilliSecs()
Delay 100
Print MilliSecs() - start >= 95
```

```text
1
```
